method: Read-only official documentation; no inference, credit or current organization rate-limit verification

sources.verified: jev-1.14.0 uses POST /v1/systemone, input USD0.042/M, output free; default 32k per-question and 64k per-request; v7 sends one question and does not enable long context. Organization rate limits require separate verification.
gpt-6-luna supports reasoning none, Responses, structured outputs and 1,050,000 context. Input USD0.10/M, output USD0.50/M. Above272k input, 2x input/cache and1.5x output apply.

gpt-6.1-sol supports reasoning low, Responses, structured outputs and1,050,000 context. Input USD2/M, output USD10/M. Above272k input,2x input/cache and1.5x output apply. Preparation-agent Ultra is not the measured low setting.
Explicit-only mode with no explicit breakpoints creates no prompt-cache reads/writes. Exact field acceptance remains an authorized-development dependency, with no silent substitution.

Native Decisions uses gpt-6-luna, input and named predicate questions; probability returned in answers. The v7 request retains the existing native contract and does not inherit Responses-only settings.

conservative_request_reservation.basis: Full accepted context ceiling, paid Responses max output, native Decisions maximum cache-write tier, and long-input multipliers; not a forecast of ordinary cost. Smaller ceilings require exact native payload/framing evidence.
